mapper.sql: ORDER_NO, TICKET_LOGIC_NUM, TICKET_PHYSICS_NUM, BEFORE_AMOUNT, TRANS_AMOUNT, AFTER_AMOUNT, STATUS,MSG, CHANNEL,PAYCENTER_ORDERNO,PAYCENTER_CHANNELORDERNO, PAY_TYPE, URL, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME, DEVICE_ID, RSV1, RSV2
mapper.insert: insert into TBL_TVM_ORDER_TOPUP ( ORDER_NO, TICKET_LOGIC_NUM, TICKET_PHYSICS_NUM, BEFORE_AMOUNT, TRANS_AMOUNT, AFTER_AMOUNT, STATUS,MSG, CHANNEL, PAY_TYPE,URL, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME, DEVICE_ID, RSV1, RSV2 ) values ( #{orderNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{ticketLogicNum,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{ticketPhysicsNum,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{beforeAmount,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{transAmount,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{afterAmount,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{msg,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{channel,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{payType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{url,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{updateTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{deviceId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{rsv1,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{rsv2,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )

insert into TBL_TVM_Topup_Notiy ( ORDER_NO, TICKET_LOGIC_NUM, TICKET_PHYSICS_NUM, trans_Date, trans_Amount, AFTER_AMOUNT, topupStatus ,trans_type,CREATE_TIME ) values ( #{orderNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{ticketLogicNum,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{ticketPhysicsNum,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{transDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{transAmount,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{afterAmount,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{topupStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{transType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
)

insert into TBL_TVM_Topup_Notiy ( ORDER_NO, TICKET_LOGIC_NUM, TICKET_PHYSICS_NUM, topupStatus,faultOccurDate, faultSlipSeq, errorCode,errorMessage,trans_type, CREATE_TIME ) values ( #{orderNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{ticketLogicNum,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{ticketPhysicsNum,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{topupStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{faultOccurDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{faultSlipSeq,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{errorCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{errorMessage,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{transType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.select: SELECT SUBSTR(CREATE_TIME, 1, 10) AS STAT_DATE, COUNT(1) AS ORDER_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS PAID_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN RSV2 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REFUND_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = '1' THEN NVL(TO_NUMBER(TRANS_AMOUNT), 0) ELSE 0 END) AS PAID_TRANS_AMOUNT_SUM FROM TBL_TVM_ORDER_TOPUP WHERE CREATE_TIME >= #{dateStart,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND CREATE_TIME <= #{dateEnd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY SUBSTR(CREATE_TIME, 1, 10) ORDER BY STAT_DATE

select topup.ORDER_NO,topup.TRANS_AMOUNT from ( (select from TBL_TVM_ORDER_TOPUP where STATUS = '1' and rsv2 is null and CREATE_TIME between #{startTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and #{endTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) app left join (select * from TBL_TVM_Topup_Notiy) notiy on topup.ORDER_NO = notiy.ORDER_NO) where notiy.ORDER_NO is null
